title: Kustomize and per-environment configuration without duplicating manifests

videos.script: Helm answers the question of different environments with templates. Kustomize answers it without any. {{templates}} Every file stays a plain, valid manifest that kubectl could apply on its own. A base holds what all environments share. An overlay holds only what one environment changes: a namespace, a replica count, an image tag. {{overlay}} Kustomize is built into kubectl, so there is nothing to install. {{builtin}} You will write a base and two overlays for the shop, build them, apply them side by side, and then change one setting in the base and watch it reach production with a rollout of its own. {{plan}}
